name: Plan Your Crib JSON API
generationRules: Return one JSON object only, with all six top-level fields.
Use globally unique stable ids and valid roomId references.
Rooms store interior polygons; do not add their perimeter walls to walls[].
Write room points in positive shoelace order and do not repeat the first point.
An opening edgeIndex addresses points[i] to points[(i+1) mod n].
Keep each opening on its edge: width/2 <= offset <= edgeLength - width/2.
Use catalog template defaults unless the user requests another footprint.
Keep furniture inside rooms and avoid overlaps unless the user asks otherwise.
